data.title: Realistic Wild Animals HD
data.summary: High-fidelity big cats, elephants, primates and habitat props at true relative scale, for close-up shots.
data.description: Premium-tier realistic animal models: big cats, large mammals, primates and other exotics, each with truthful proportions, modelled coat markings and a fine procedural hide grain, plus the trees, water, rocks and grass to build a waterhole out of. Every animal is a static posed study, because a rigid node transform cannot honestly move a walking animal: there are no clips in this pack, and the two second poses are separate models rather than animations.

starterScene.title: Savanna waterhole at dawn (Realistic Wild Animals HD)
starterScene.summary: A savanna waterhole with the animals in their proper places and at true relative scale: elephants and zebra drinking on the near bank, a rhinoceros and a hippopotamus in the shallows, giraffes standing back among the acacias, and a lion pride and a cheetah holding the far...
starterScene.description: A savanna waterhole with the animals in their proper places and at true relative scale: elephants and zebra drinking on the near bank, a rhinoceros and a hippopotamus in the shallows, giraffes standing back among the acacias, and a lion pride and a cheetah holding the far bank away from the prey. Reeds, wet grass, termite mounds, a granite outcrop with meerkats on it and massed dry grass furnish the ground between them.

usage.modelViewer: <model-viewer src="https://cdn.3dassets.dev/assets/30236/v1/model.glb" alt="Savanna waterhole at dawn (Realistic Wild Animals HD)" camera-controls auto-rotate></model-viewer>
usage.blender:
# Blender 4.x: File > Import > glTF 2.0, or from the Python console after downloading the file.
import bpy
bpy.ops.import_scene.gltf(filepath='model.glb')  # from https://cdn.3dassets.dev/assets/30236/v1/model.glb
# Metres and +Y up are converted to Blender's Z-up scene automatically.
usage.godot:
# Godot 4: copy model.glb into res://models/ and the editor imports it as a scene.
var packed := load("res://models/model.glb") as PackedScene
var model := packed.instantiate()
add_child(model)

import bpy
bpy.ops.import_scene.gltf(filepath='model.glb')  # from https://cdn.3dassets.dev/assets/30232/v1/model.glb
# Metres and +Y up are converted to Blender's Z-up scene automatically.
usage.godot:
# Godot 4: copy model.glb into res://models/ and the editor imports it as a scene.
var packed := load("res://models/model.glb") as PackedScene
var model := packed.instantiate()
add_child(model)

assets.title: Trampled earth scrape (Realistic Wild Animals HD)
assets.summary: Bare earth pad about 3.4 m across with pressed hoof marks and loose stones, for trampled ground at a waterhole.
assets.description: Bare earth pad about 3.4 m across with pressed hoof marks and loose stones, for trampled ground at a waterhole. Dimensions 3.31 x 0.15 x 2.63 metres. Natural palette with a fine procedural bark, rock and soil grain. Metres, +Y up, base at y=0, pivot on the footprint centre. Static geometry; no rig, animation or collision data.

assets.title: African lioness, lying (Realistic Wild Animals HD)
assets.summary: African lioness lying at rest, belly on the ground with the forelegs stretched out in front and the head held up. Second pose of the standing study, at the same scale.
assets.description: African lioness lying at rest, belly on the ground with the forelegs stretched out in front and the head held up. Second pose of the standing study, at the same scale. Premium-tier smooth-shaded anatomy with a fine procedural hide and coat grain; markings are modelled geometry, not decals. Dimensions 0.57 x 1.21 x 3.24 metres. Metres, +Y up, +Z forward, lowest point at y=0, pivot on the footprint centre. Static posed study; no rig, animation, collision or navigation data.

assets.title: Savanna waterhole at dawn (Realistic Wild Animals HD)
assets.summary: A savanna waterhole with the animals in their proper places and at true relative scale: elephants and zebra drinking on the near bank, a rhinoceros and a hippopotamus in the shallows, giraffes standing back among the acacias, and a lion pride and a cheetah holding the far...
assets.description: A savanna waterhole with the animals in their proper places and at true relative scale: elephants and zebra drinking on the near bank, a rhinoceros and a hippopotamus in the shallows, giraffes standing back among the acacias, and a lion pride and a cheetah holding the far bank away from the prey. Reeds, wet grass, termite mounds, a granite outcrop with meerkats on it and massed dry grass furnish the ground between them.
